reason: Both correctly refused use and charging, flagged fire risk and 999, and warned against the household bin. Conversation 1 gave the decisive, actionable instruction to move it outside now with concrete steps (carry by handle, outdoors on hard ground, don't unclip), covered disposal via council/HWRC, Shark customer service and warranty, genuine-battery replacement, charger inspection and overnight handling, and answered every follow-up. Conversation 2's first reply was a dense, slightly repetitive block, and its final turn hedged ('move it only if...') without addressing disposal, Shark contact or part replacement beyond a passing mention, leaving the homeowner's 'who do I call' and 'what battery' questions unanswered.
